$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 247, scoped by the maintainer on 2026-09-26 to the hook-host half. Refact already speaks the converged hook convention and reads .claude/settings.json, so a repository governed for Claude Code looked governed under Refact and was not: four defects each made the hook fall open (project_dir, tool_output, *_textdoc/mv/rm/merge tool names, a dropped args array). C1-C4 pin each. C5 pins the capture bug found on the LIVE host (a quoted completion.py path recorded nothing), which affects every host. THE VACUITY THIS BAR IS BUILT AGAINST: a gate that refuses every tool passes C1-C3, so C4 asserts that reads and near-miss names (format, confirm, buddy_memory_merge) are NOT treated as file changes. WHAT THIS BAR CANNOT CHECK: behaviour on a running Refact host. That was verified by hand on Refact 8.6.4 (three runs, one model; recorded in PR 249), not by anything a commit can re-run.

covers.declared: Refact governed as an ADR-029 hook host: the shared hook reads Refact's payload, gates its file-changing tools with exit 2, captures verdicts from its shell tool, and ships an installable template
covers.uncovered: the provider half (adapters/refact over .refact/tasks) and Buddy as an observer whose mined decisions are audited against authority
covers.split_note: Split by the maintainer before this bar was read, not after it reached STOP_COMPLETE. 251 is the adapter the issue's own Acceptance section described; 252 is the decision audit that came out of observing Buddy on a real repository. 248 (agents admitting their own work) was found while verifying this and is separate work, not a split.

criteria.$comment: C1 the payload: project_dir finds the repository from the daemon's cwd, and tool_output is read
criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/hooks.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] refact: capture finds the repo from project_dir and reads tool_output"'

criteria.$comment: C2 every Refact file-changing tool is blocked with exit 2 under a refusal, including the planner's merge tools
criteria.target: bash -c '[ "$(python3 conformance/hooks.py | grep -c "\[PASS\] refact: .* is blocked with exit 2")" = 10 ]'

criteria.$comment: C3 the shipped template: anchored matcher, single command string, --exit2-on-deny, capture on shell
criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/hooks.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] refact hooks use a single command string, no args array"'

criteria.$comment: C4 CONTROL: reads and near-miss names are not file changes. Without this, a gate that refuses everything passes C2.
criteria.target: bash -c '[ "$(python3 conformance/hooks.py | grep -c "\[PASS\] refact: .* is not treated as a file change")" = 6 ]'

criteria.$comment: C5 found on the live host: a quoted completion.py invocation is captured, on every host
criteria.target: bash -c '[ "$(python3 conformance/hooks.py | grep -c "\[PASS\] capture survives a quoted invocation")" = 3 ]'
